chunks: Commémorate Enoch in the Book. He was a truthful person and a prophet,

key_terms.إِدْرِيسَ: Idris (Enoch), a prophet mentioned in the Quran
key_terms.صِدِّيقًا: Truthful one, a high rank of prophetic virtue

ai.seo_question: Who is Idris in the Quran and what does the title Siddiq mean?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, Idris is often identified with the pre-Mahdi prophet or linked to the lineage of the Ahl al-Bayt, emphasizing his role as a precursor to the final prophetic cycle. The title 'Siddiq' here underscores his unwavering commitment to divine truth, a quality highly valued in Shia piety alongside prophethood. This verse serves not only as historical narration but as a spiritual model for believers to emulate in their pursuit of sincerity and closeness to God.
